blocks.path:/v1/projects/{projectId}/skills/{sk:
/v1/projects/{projectId}/skills/{skill}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ProjectId'
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/SkillName'
    patch:
      tags: [Projects]
      operationId: updateProjectSkill
      x-kokoro-owner: kokoro-bff
      x-kokoro-visibility: public
      x-kokoro-stability: beta
      x-kokoro-idempotency: required
      x-kokoro-permission: project.update
      summary: Update project skill state
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProjectSkillRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Project skill state
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProjectSkillResponse'
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
        '409': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Conflict' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed' }
        '429':
          description: IAM session admission is rate limited
          headers:
            Retry-After:
              description: Bounded delay in seconds before retrying admission
              schema: { type: string, pattern: '^[1-9][0-9]{0,4}$' }
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
        '503': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable' }
blocks.schema:ProjectSkillRequest:
ProjectSkillRequest:
      type: object
      required: [enabled]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        enabled: { type: boolean }
blocks.schema:ProjectSkillResponse:
ProjectSkillResponse:
      type: object
      required: [data, meta]
      properties:
        data:
          type: object
          required: [skill]
          properties:
            skill:
              type: object
              required: [project_id, name, enabled]
              properties:
                project_id: { type: string }
                name: { type: string }
                enabled: { type: boolean }
        meta: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/RequestMeta' }
blocks.schema:MessageCreateRequest:
MessageCreateRequest:
      type: object
      required: [content]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        content:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 100000
        model: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        agent: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        thinking: { type: boolean }
        selected_skill_source_refs:
          type: array
          maxItems: 16
          uniqueItems: true
          x-kokoro-json-byte-limit: 4096
          description: Exact ordered Skill source references; omission means []. Compact UTF-8 JSON must not exceed 4096 bytes.
          items:
            type: string
            minLength: 7
            maxLength: 197
            pattern: '^skill:(?!skill:)[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,190}(?![\s\S])'
        mcp_servers:
          type: array
          items: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        project_ref: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      example:
        content: Review the latest project changes.
        model: default
        project_ref: project_kokoro
blocks.schema:ChatMessage:
ChatMessage:
      type: object
      required: [message_id, role, content, status, created_at]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        message_id: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        role:
          type: string
          enum: [user, assistant]
        content: { type: string }
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [pending, streaming, completed, failed]
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        run_id: { type: string }
        failure:
          type: object
          required: [source, code, retryable]
          additionalProperties: false
          properties:
            source: { type: string, const: agent }
            code:
              type: string
              enum:
                - token_budget_exceeded
                - recursion_limit_exceeded
                - assembly_failed
                - enqueue_failed
                - dispatch_exhausted
                - contract_incompatible
                - internal_error
                - model_unavailable
                - dependency_unavailable
                - model_access_denied
            retryable: { type: boolean }
          if:
            properties:
              retryable: { const: true }
          then:
            properties:
              code: { enum: [model_unavailable, dependency_unavailable] }
      allOf:
        - if:
            required: [failure]
          then:
            required: [run_id]
            properties:
              role: { const: assistant }
              status: { const: failed }
              run_id: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      example:
        message_id: msg_01JUSER
        role: user
        content: Review the contract
        status: completed
        created_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
        run_id: run_01JASYNC
blocks.parameter:SkillName:
SkillName:
      name: skill
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
blocks.path:/v1/sessions/{id}/messages:
/v1/sessions/{id}/messages:
    parameters:
      - $ref: '#/components/parameters/SessionId'
    get:
      tags: [Chat]
      operationId: listSessionMessages
      x-kokoro-owner: kokoro-bff
      x-kokoro-visibility: public
      x-kokoro-stability: beta
      x-kokoro-idempotency: none
      x-kokoro-permission: chat.session.read
      summary: List session messages
      description: Cursor-paginated message history for a session. This is the v1 equivalent of Manus task.listMessages; session detail remains a bounded metadata snapshot.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/DirectScopeQuery'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ProjectRefQuery'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/LimitQuery'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CursorQuery'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Cursor-paginated session messages
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/SessionMessageListResponse'
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
        '429':
          description: IAM session admission is rate limited
          headers:
            Retry-After:
              description: Bounded delay in seconds before retrying admission
              schema: { type: string, pattern: '^[1-9][0-9]{0,4}$' }
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
        '503': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable' }
    post:
      tags: [Chat]
      operationId: createMessage
      x-kokoro-owner: kokoro-bff
      x-kokoro-visibility: public
      x-kokoro-stability: beta
      x-kokoro-idempotency: required
      x-kokoro-permission: chat.message.create
      summary: Submit a session message
      description: >-
        For an absent client-created conv_<UUID> session, the first accepted message atomically
        creates a private active session owned by the admitted tenant and subject, derives its
        title from the first message, and queues the Agent run. Existing active sessions continue
        normally. Deleted or foreign session identifiers remain not found; the identifier itself
        grants no access. Replaying the same idempotency key and request returns the original receipt.
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/DirectScopeQuery'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ProjectRefQuery'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/MessageCreateRequest'
            example:
              content: Review the latest project changes.
              model: default
              project_ref: project_kokoro
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Message receipt
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/MessageReceiptResponse'
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' }
        '409': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Conflict' }
        '413': { $ref: '#/components/responses/PayloadTooLarge' }
        '503': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable' }
        '429':
          description: IAM session admission is rate limited
          headers:
            Retry-After:
              description: Bounded delay in seconds before retrying admission
              schema: { type: string, pattern: '^[1-9][0-9]{0,4}$' }
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope' }
